record.question: Which of the following is not true regarding the Power of a Special Judge under the PC Act?
options: He may take cognizance of the offences without the accused being commissioned to him for trial
In trying the accused person, he shall follow the procedure prescribed by the Cr.P.C for the trial of warrant cases by Magistrate

He may tender pardon to a person supposed to have been directly or indirectly concerned in an offence in order to obtain the evidence provided such person would make full and true disclosure of the whole circumstances within his knowledge related to the offence.
All of the above is true
